unit: one review; multiple themes allowed; a theme mention is not automatically a complaint or improvement request

themes.definition: Explicit reported result, effectiveness or lack of result. Generic praise alone does not establish a specific benefit.
Ease/effort of application, removal, handling, control placement, dispensing or physical fit. Record product-specific aspect separately.
Wear/smudge/flake/adhesion, stability during use, useful life or device failure. These are different aspects under one broad parent theme.
Protection, container/closure, transport damage, receipt condition or completeness. Pure appearance belongs to T05; price/quantity belongs to T08.
Explicit smell, texture, color, sound or physical appearance. Lash volume/length and cleaning outcomes belong primarily to T01.
Subjective discomfort or absence of it, such as itching or vibration sensitivity. Never code clinical causality or safety as established.
Explicit comparison with description, claimed feature, instruction, photo or an identifiable expectation; not generic disappointment alone.

themes.label_pt: Preço, quantidade e custo de uso
themes.definition: Explicit perceived value, price, quantity or cost of consumables. Not measured commercial impact.
Explicit context such as humidity, travel, hair type, routine or stated preference. Do not infer demographics, segments or causality.
Explicit repurchase/discontinuation intention, return, warranty or support. Record those different aspects separately.

consistency.compatible: Review explicitly describes the expected product class or a diagnostic feature; does not prove exact SKU/version.
consistency.generic: No incompatible statement, but review is too nonspecific to confirm product class independently.
consistency.variant_unclear: Review reports a version, bundle, label or appearance discrepancy; not proof of unrelated product.
consistency.incompatible_type: Explicitly describes a different product type; requires independent review before exclusion.

request_interpretation: product_or_packaging includes an explicit suggestion or desired attribute, even a preference for an alternative product; it does not necessarily mean a formal request to the manufacturer. Commercial price/support requests are separate. Neither type establishes prioritization or feasibility.
coding_rules: Code the text rather than infer sentiment from star rating.
A comparison with another brand is not proof of a catalog mismatch.
Mentions of free products or alleged incentives are source-quality flags, not proof of fraud.
Keep explicit requests separate from analyst proposals inferred from problems.
Counts from a rating-stratified audit are sample descriptions, not population prevalence.
The assistant's coding is an initial proposal, not human annotation or the final RAG reference.
The same broad codebook applies to all three cohorts. Theme count depends on granularity and is not a validated diversity score.
